title: Digestion of starch and absorption of glucose
compartment: Mouth and small-intestinal lumen; brush border, cytosol and basolateral membrane of enterocytes

steps.note: Hydrolyses internal α-1,4 links and bypasses α-1,6 branch points
Brush-border exohydrolases; SI supplies almost all α-1,6 activity
Secondary active transport across the apical membrane
Facilitated diffusion across the basolateral membrane
